notes.title: First update: Beer runner
notes.content: [p]You can now play an endless level where you can drink [b]infinite beer[/b] and keep running [b]forever[/b]. The more you drink, the crazier it gets!! after [b]25 beers[/b], experience a variety of unique effects that make the gameplay even more wild and exciting![/p][p][/p]
